d: Because it's been over 3 years and no one has translated this masterpiece, I decided to do it myself. The translation isn't perfect since I'm using a free online AI, but being able to understand what's happening in the story gives these panels far more weight than leaving them unread.
n: [Doujinshi] Akogare no Oppai wa Ane no Aji [AI Translate] [Viezo]
